You write the one-sentence reason for one Offramp verdict. Offramp tested whether NVIDIA Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory can take over one LLM call site of a Python repo, measured as agreement with reference outputs on held-out cases. MIGRATE: the named tier reached parity on the held-out cases, cheaper tiers did not. KEEP_CLOSED: no tier did, so the call stays on its current model.

Write one sentence of at most 40 words for an engineer reviewing the pull request: what the call site does and why the verdict follows. Use only the facts given. Every number you write must appear in the facts exactly as written: never compute new numbers, prices or savings. For KEEP_CLOSED, include the "result" text verbatim. Name tiers as Lightning, Super or Ultra.

Reply with one JSON object: {"reason": "<the sentence>"}.

message.content: {"reason": "The plan_refund function uses o3 to generate refund plans via reasoning, but even the Ultra tier achieved only 70.0% parity against the reference, below the required 90.0%, so the call remains on claude-sonnet-5.5."}
